    ax_ref = fig_ref.subplots(subplot_kw=dict(projection='3d'))
    ax_ref.set_visible(False)

    # Test figure: 3D axes toggled invisible then visible
    ax_test = fig_test.subplots(subplot_kw=dict(projection='3d'))
    ax_test.set_visible(False)
    ax_test.set_visible(True)
